strategy.name: Macro News Events (NFP / CPI / FOMC)
strategy.summary: Protect before big US news, then fade a whipsaw on mixed data or join a true surprise after a retrace.

rules.text: Cancel resting limit orders 10 minutes before CPI/NFP/FOMC; respect your firm's confirmed news window.
rules.checklistQuestion: Were resting orders cancelled before the release?

rules.text: Playbook 1 (mixed data): first 1–3 min sweep a 4H level, then a 5m close back beyond the pre-news price → enter the reversal.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was there a sweep and a 5m close back?

rules.text: Playbook 2 (surprise > 2σ): wait 15–30 min for a 50% retrace or the 5m FVG, then enter in the surprise direction.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did you wait 15–30 min for the retrace?

rules.text: Stop beyond the spike extreme (P1) or beyond the pre-news price (P2).
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the stop beyond the spike / pre-news price?
Was the planned R:R between 2 and 4?
